title: 第二十章   胜
content_zh:
平静下来的琼霄，缓缓的把腿上的护膝解了下来，丢到了战台的一旁，随着护膝落地，地面上突然被砸出了一个坑洞，看到掉落在战台出砸出深坑的护膝，蓝湘瞳孔微微一缩，“这东西有些古怪！”没等蓝湘反应过来，琼霄又将手臂上的护臂解了下来，丢在了护膝旁边，无一例外的，护臂也砸出了一个坑洞。

    望着琼霄解下来的东西能在战台上砸出坑洞来，那美目充满了不可思议的眼神，便缓缓的开口道：“你平常都带着着东西战斗吗？”

    “这是我的修炼内容，学姐，让我们继续我们未完成的战斗吧！”

    轰！随着琼霄的声音一落，强大的星力从琼霄体内涌出来，琼霄的气息节节攀升，短短数息之间，琼霄的气息已经超过了**境中期。

    望着气息暴涨的琼霄，蓝湘的面色出现了一丝凝重。

    嘭！琼霄的气息瞬间冲天而起，一股比**境后期还强横的气息弥漫开来，只不过还没有进入玄星境。

    “你隐藏了实力！”蓝湘紧盯着琼霄面目凝重道。

    “呵呵，如果不拿出真正的力量，我恐怕还真没有把握胜学姐你！”琼霄对着蓝湘微笑道。

    既然如此那就来吧，我看看你究竟还有着多少底牌！”说着，蓝湘体内的星力也是完完全全调动了起来，旋即冲着琼霄暴掠而去。

    “哈哈！来得正好！”望着极速而来的的蓝湘，琼霄大笑一声，双拳与蓝湘双掌狠狠撞在了一起。

    嘭！两人所在的地方，地面被凭空震出一个一丈高的深坑。身处深坑之中的两个人拳掌依旧相碰着，冲击波从拳掌之间散发出来，冲击着掉落的土石。

    “喝！”随着两人低沉的声音响起，两人同时倒飞而出，停住身形的两人紧盯着对方，旋即轻轻一跃，跳出了深坑。

    身处深坑旁边的两人相互望着对手，周身的星力高速涌动着，见到蓝湘没有动手，琼霄便率先动手，没有了武器的蓝湘与琼霄，现在只能以肉搏的方式来解决战斗。

    砰！砰！砰！一掌掌接下琼霄的手掌，蓝湘心里充满了惊讶！“他的攻击速度比起先前更快了！他是怎么做到的？”

    正在攻击的琼霄琼霄看到蓝湘眼里露出的一丝疑惑便开口道：“学姐！战斗中分心可不行！”话音一落，琼霄一个回旋踢朝着蓝湘而去。

    闻言，蓝湘顿时反应了过来，琼霄的一记回旋踢也随之而来，有些措手不及的蓝湘，只是匆忙用手护住身体，抵挡琼霄凌厉的攻势。

    砰！琼霄一脚将蓝湘踢得倒飞出去，随着蓝湘倒飞出去，琼霄没有任何停手的意思，也冲着蓝湘的方向冲去。

    “你！”此刻的蓝湘有些气急败坏，慌忙的应对着琼霄的拳脚。

    砰！蓝湘便再度倒飞了出去，慌忙停住身形的她，脸上浮现了一丝恼怒的表情，这次她第一次在玄星境以下的人手中吃亏，在刚才的肉搏之中，她明显有些落下下风，这是她所没有想到的。

    美目紧紧盯着琼霄，蓝湘红唇缓缓张开道：“没想到，你脱下了这些东西，速度居然会提升这么多，恐怕玄星境以下，没有人会是你的对手了！”

    “多谢学姐谬赞了，不过，战斗还未结束，希望学姐不要再分心，拳脚可不长眼！”

    “多谢提醒，不过我还是那句话！想要从我手中取得胜利，我只能说此路不通！”

    “打通便是！”话音还未落下，琼霄脚尖一点，便再度冲了上去。

    “哼！”娇躯冷吭一声，便与琼霄缠斗在了一起，一阵阵破风的声音响彻整个战台，两人战斗的地方，冲击波不停着冲刷着战台原本已经破碎的地面。
content_en:
Qiong Xiao calmed down and slowly took off the knee pads on his legs and threw them to the side of the fighting platform. As the knee pads fell to the ground, a hole was suddenly made on the ground. When he saw the knee pads that fell on the fighting platform and made a deep hole,Lan Xiang's pupils shrank slightly, "This thing is a bit weird!" Before Lan Xiang could react, Qiong Xiao took off the arm guard from his arm and threw it next to the knee pad. Without exception, the arm guard also made a hole.

Seeing that the things Qiong Xiao had untied could make holes on the battlefield, her beautiful eyes were full of incredulity, and she slowly said: "Do you usually carry things with you to fight?"

"This is my training content, senior sister, let's continue our unfinished battle!"

Boom!As soon as Qiong Xiao's voice fell, powerful star power surged out of Qiong Xiao's body. Qiong Xiao's aura was rising steadily. In just a few breaths, Qiong Xiao's aura had exceeded the middle stage of the ** realm.

Looking at Qiong Xiao, whose aura was soaring, Lan Xiang's face showed a hint of solemnity.

Bang!Qiong Xiao's aura instantly rose into the sky, and an aura that was more powerful than that in the late stage of the ** realm filled the air, but he had not yet entered the Xuanxing realm.

"You are hiding your strength!" Lan Xiang stared at Qiong Xiao and said solemnly.

"Haha, if I don't show my true strength, I'm afraid I won't be able to defeat you, senior sister!" Qiong Xiao smiled at Lan Xiang.

In that case, come on, let me see how many trump cards you have!"As he said that, the star power in Lan Xiang's body was fully mobilized, and he immediately rushed towards Qiong Xiao.

"Haha!Just in time!"Looking at Lan Xiang coming at a very fast speed, Qiong Xiao laughed loudly and collided hard with Lan Xiang's palms with both fists.

Bang!Where the two of them were, a deep pit one foot high was created out of thin air on the ground.The fists of the two people in the deep pit were still touching each other, and shock waves emanated from between their fists, impacting the falling earth and rocks.

"Drink!"As the deep voices of the two people rang out, the two people flew out at the same time. The two people who stopped and stared at each other closely, then jumped out of the pit with a slight jump.

The two people standing next to the pit looked at each other. The star power around them was surging at a high speed. Seeing that Lan Xiang did not make a move, Qiong Xiao took the lead. Without weapons, Lan Xiang and Qiong Xiao could only resolve the battle through hand-to-hand combat.

Bang!Bang!Bang!Taking Qiong Xiao's palm with one palm, Lan Xiang was filled with surprise!"His attack speed is faster than before!How did he do it?"

Qiong Xiao, who was attacking, saw a trace of doubt in Lan Xiang's eyes and said, "Senior!It's not okay to be distracted during a battle!"As soon as he finished speaking, Qiong Xiao flew towards Lan Xiang with a roundhouse kick.

Hearing this, Lan Xiang reacted immediately, and a roundhouse kick from Qiong Xiao followed. Lan Xiang, who was a little caught off guard, just hurriedly protected his body with his hands to resist Qiong Xiao's fierce attack.

Bang!Qiong Xiao kicked Lan Xiang backwards and flew backwards. As Lan Xiang flew backwards, Qiong Xiao showed no intention of stopping and rushed towards Lan Xiang.

"You!"At this moment, Lan Xiang was a little angry and hurriedly responded to Qiong Xiao's fists and kicks.

Bang!Lan Xiang flew backwards again. She hurriedly stopped, with an angry expression on her face. This time she suffered a loss at the hands of someone below the Xuanxing realm for the first time. In the melee fight just now, she was obviously at a disadvantage. This was something she did not expect.

Staring at Qiong Xiao with her beautiful eyes, Lan Xiang slowly opened her red lips and said: "I didn't expect that your speed would increase so much after taking off these things. I'm afraid no one below the Xuanxing realm will be your opponent!"

"Thank you very much, Senior, for your compliments. However, the battle is not over yet. I hope that Senior will not be distracted anymore. Fists and kicks are not very good!"

"Thanks for reminding me, but I still say the same thing!If you want to win from my hands, I can only say that this road is blocked!"

"Just get through it!" Before the words could even be finished, Qiong Xiao tiptoed and rushed forward again.

"Hmph!"Jiaozu said coldly, and then they fought with Qiong Xiao. The sound of breaking wind resounded throughout the battle platform. Where the two were fighting, shock waves kept washing over the already broken ground of the battle platform.
